# Sedifex

Public guides for using Sedifex. These guides do not grant account access.

## Help Centre
- [Help Centre](https://sedifex.com/help.html)
- [Create your Sedifex account](https://sedifex.com/help/sign-up.html): Sign up, verify your email and reach your business workspace.
- [Set up your business workspace](https://sedifex.com/help/business-setup.html): Choose your business type, save your details and start your first task.
- [Add products, services and courses](https://sedifex.com/help/products-and-sales.html): Build your catalog and choose the right workflow for a sale or appointment.
- [Manage bookings, reminders and payments](https://sedifex.com/help/bookings-and-payments.html): Keep attendance, business approval and payment status clear.
- [Connect a website to Sedifex](https://sedifex.com/help/integrations.html): Create an integration key and test a read-only catalog request from your server.
- [Fix common setup and integration problems](https://sedifex.com/help/troubleshooting.html): Find the next check for signup, workspaces, payments and API errors.

## Integration source
- [Canonical contract](https://github.com/learngermanghana/sedifex/blob/main/docs/integration-contract.md)
- [API guide](https://github.com/learngermanghana/sedifex/blob/main/docs/integration-api-guide.md)

Use placeholder credentials. Do not request secrets or private customer/payment records.
